name: @pipeworx/mcp-ulid

tools.name: generate_ulid
tools.description: Generate one or more ULIDs (time-sortable unique IDs). Each is a 26-char Crockford Base32 string whose first 10 chars encode the creation time.

tools.name: parse_ulid
tools.description: Validate a ULID and extract its embedded creation timestamp (ISO date + epoch ms) and the random component. Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ulid forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ulid pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
